import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
print(sorted(G))
for k in ['Demo pair 1 input','Demo pair 1 output','Demo pair 2 input','Demo pair 2 output']:
    g=G[k]
    cells=[(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row)]
    bg=max(set(v for _,_,v in cells), key=lambda x: sum(1 for _,_,vv in cells if vv==x))
    print(k, 'bg',bg, [(r,c,v) for r,c,v in cells if v!=bg])

def apply_line_rule(g):
    bg = Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W = len(g), len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for mode in (0,1):
        lines={}
        for r in range(H):
            for c in range(W):
                k=(r-c) if mode==0 else (r+c)
                if g[r][c]!=bg: lines.setdefault(k,[]).append((r,c,g[r][c]))
        for k,cells in lines.items():
            if len(cells)<2: continue
            cells=sorted(cells)
            for end,step in ((cells[0],-1),(cells[-1],1)):
                r,c,_=end
                dr,dc=(step,step) if mode==0 else (step,-step)
                rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                while 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and g[rr][cc]==bg:
                    out[rr][cc]=end[2]; rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    return out

def parse_pair(i, name):
    txt=lines[i]['message']['content'][0]['text']
    grids={}

        h,w=int(mm.group(1)),int(mm.group(2))
        rows=[]
        for m in re.finditer(r'((?:\d+ ){%d}\d+)' % (w-1), seg):
            row=[int(x) for x in m.group(1).split()]
            if len(row)==w: rows.append(row)
            if len(rows)==h: break
        grids[hdr]=rows
        print(hdr, 'dims', h, w, 'got rows', len(rows))

WALLS={0,3,4,6,7,9}
def apply_v2(g):
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    _,runs=runs_of(g)
    for mode,run in runs:
        if len(run)<2: continue
        col=g[run[0][0]][run[0][1]]
        d0,d1=dirs_for(mode)   # d0 = up, d1 = down (increasing r)
        fwd_only = col in (5,9)
        for end,d in ((run[0],d0),(run[-1],d1)):
            if fwd_only and d==d0: continue
            r2,c2=end[0]+d[0],end[1]+d[1]; path=[]
            while 0<=r2<H and 0<=c2<W and g[r2][c2]==bg:
                path.append((r2,c2)); r2+=d[0]; c2+=d[1]
            if not (0<=r2<H and 0<=c2<W):
                cells=path
            else:
                t=g[r2][c2]
                if t in WALLS: cells=[]
                else: cells=path+[(r2,c2)]   # absorb non-wall single, stop
            for p in cells: out[p[0]][p[1]]=col
    return out

    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    _,runs=runs_of(g)
    run_cells={p for _,run in runs for p in run if len(run)>=2}
    for mode,run in runs:
        if len(run)<2: continue
        col=g[run[0][0]][run[0][1]]
        d0,d1=dirs_for(mode)
        fwd_only = col in (5,9)
        for end,d in ((run[0],d0),(run[-1],d1)):
            if fwd_only and d==d0: continue
            r2,c2=end[0]+d[0],end[1]+d[1]; path=[]
            while 0<=r2<H and 0<=c2<W and g[r2][c2]==bg:
                path.append((r2,c2)); r2+=d[0]; c2+=d[1]
            if not (0<=r2<H and 0<=c2<W):
                cells=path
            else:
                t=g[r2][c2]
                if t in WALLS or (r2,c2) in run_cells: cells=[]
                else: cells=path+[(r2,c2)]
            for p in cells: out[p[0]][p[1]]=col
    return out
